verdict.rationale: Databricks documents managed (built-in system.ai) and custom MCP servers hosted on the platform. External clients such as Claude, Cursor and MCP Inspector can be wired up to them, and agent code can discover, authenticate to and call them [databricks-docs-45, databricks-docs-50, databricks-docs-71, databricks-probe-3]. MCP services are also governed as Unity Catalog objects [databricks-docs-75]. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that external agents connect successfully, and detail on which tools and data the managed MCP servers expose and on the client authentication setup.
